exchanges: Hey there. Long day at the garden, Bongani had us building new compost bins
That sounds like real work. Did you get them finished?
almost. hes so strong, he grew up in Durban on his uncles farm so this is nothing to him
That background must help with all the heavy jobs.
meanwhile i can barely lift a shovel lol
Everyone brings something different to the garden.
true true. my sister Aiko phoned, shes moving in with her partner Mitchell finally after 6 yrs
Six years is a good long time to be sure.
took them long enough haha
Some people like to take their time.
and get this, i ran into an old student at the grocery store, also named Aiko!! she introduced me to her fiance Ravi
What a nice surprise. How long ago did you teach her?
grade 3, maybe 25 years ago. made me feel ancient
Seeing former students grown up is a special thing.
i do pilates at the Y every Thursday, keeps me from feeling too ancient
Pilates is great for strength and balance.
my husband Henrik thinks its silly, he'd rather sit and read the paper
Maybe he should come along one week.
ha never. were watching hockey tonight, my Canadiens are losing again, i've cheered for them since i was a girl
Loyal through the losing seasons, that is real devotion.
devotion or stupidity lol
A bit of both, maybe.
my granddaughter zainab came by with her fiance yesterday
How lovely. Are they planning the wedding?
yes shes getting married in August, at his parents cottage
A summer wedding at a cottage sounds beautiful.
i have to find a dress. i havent bought a dress since 2009
That gives you a good excuse to shop.
oh wait, i said bongani grew up in durban but i had it wrong, it was Soweto. he set me straight today lol
Good to know, thanks for fixing that.
for dinner i made lasagna, my favourite thing in the world to eat
A good comfort meal.
henrik had 2 helpings so he cant complain
Sounds like it was a hit.
my neighbour pilar came over for a slice too, she just lost her cat so i wanted to cheer her up
That was kind of you. Losing a pet is hard.
after she left i put on Bridgerton, i know its silly but i love the dresses
It is fun to watch, and the costumes are a big part of the appeal.
Henrik is grumpy tonight, the doctor says hes got shingles and its very painful
I am sorry, that sounds very hard on him. Is he on medication for it?
whats the name of the guy my sister aiko is living with
yes hes got pills, hopefully they work fast
I hope so too. Rest will help.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your sister Aiko's partner is Mitchell.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your sister Aiko's partner is Ravi.
